meaning.en: Slaughter of an animal by cutting its throat and allowing it to bleed out, especially for the production of halal and kosher meat.
meaning.vi: Giết động vật bằng cách cắt cổ họng và để máu chảy ra, đặc biệt là để sản xuất thịt halal và kosher.

meaning.en: (pathology) Excessive loss of blood due to hemorrhage.
meaning.vi: (bệnh lý) Mất nhiều máu do xuất huyết.

meaning_vi: sự hút hết máu; sự kiệt máu

sentences.en: Death is mainly because of exsanguination or liver failure.

sentences.en: All operations were done under regional anaesthesia with exsanguination of the limb.

sentences.en: The two primary causes of death are associated head injury and vascular injuries that cause exsanguination or stroke.

sentences.en: Methods High ligation of GSV combined with PFS with the assist of tourniquet and exsanguination was performed in 126 patients (156 affected limbs).

sentences.en: Sometimes it can close off the edges of hidden lacerations. Hold off exsanguination.

sentences.en: Methods:The significance of elastic repelling thrombosis method was described according to the principle of exsanguination of extremities surgery based on the treatment experience of 28 patients.
sentences.vi: Phương pháp: Ý nghĩa của phương pháp đẩy lùi huyết khối bằng đàn hồi được mô tả theo nguyên tắc phẫu thuật ngoại chi dựa trên kinh nghiệm điều trị của 28 bệnh nhân.
